svg.title: After the close: code settles the call and the record feeds the next one
svg.desc: One real call on its market calendar: Goldwind, published 2026-10-08 by the model, marked by code at the next close 4.22 percent lower and settled as a loss; its five and twenty session marks are not reached yet. A call ends as a win, a loss or ungradeable, and all three are published; an ungradeable call stays out of the hit rate instead of being guessed. On the live desk execution, settlement, history and calibration feed the next brief. In any other harness an observed outcome can anchor a bounded proposal that a named review accepts or rejects, applied with a way back. A directional evaluation is not realized P&L and nothing here promises returns.

text.tspan: AFTER THE CLOSE · SETTLE, THEN LEARN
Code settles the call. The record teaches the next one.
Wins, losses and the calls that cannot be graded all stay on the page.
One call on the calendar: Goldwind · 02208
The model wrote this call once. From there on, only code touches it.
It went the call's way by the mark.
It did not. Published the same way,
No clean price to mark it on.
Published; kept out of the hit rate.
On the desk, the next brief starts here
In any other harness, a reviewed change
Only evidence requirements change. Strategy does not.
A directional evaluation is not realized P&L. A diagnostic, not proof of return.
